entry_timing.explanation:
Entry timing is a weighted average of independent factors, each scored from -100 (poor moment) to +100 (good moment):

  Bollinger position = 111% of band -> -98 (weight 1.2) - 0% = lower band, 100% = upper band
  distance to EMA20 = +6.53% -> -39 (weight 1.8) - Price 2,629.76 vs EMA20 2,468.66
  MACD divergence (1h) = bearish -> -27 (weight 1.3) - strength 78/100
  RSI divergence (1d) = bearish -> -23 (weight 1.3) - strength 67/100
  resistance proximity = 16.2% away -> +25 (weight 1.0) - Room before the next resistance
  volume = 0.57x average -> -20 (weight 1.0) - Thin participation - moves made on low volume are less reliable
  RSI daily = 65.3 -> -12 (weight 1.2) - Neutral momentum zone
  RSI 1h = 56.8 -> -2 (weight 2.0) - Neutral momentum zone

  weighted sum / total weight (10.8) = -24.8 -> UNFAVORABLE
  Note: an imminent scheduled macro release is applied as a CAP on the score (weight 0 above), never averaged in - it can only worsen the moment.

Thresholds: >= +45 VERY_FAVORABLE, >= +15 FAVORABLE, -15..+15 WAIT, <= -15 UNFAVORABLE, <= -45 VERY_UNFAVORABLE.
